# Shop monorepo
The production service runs with NODE_ENV=production and the source-runtime export condition.
POST /orders uses the real identity-keyed query bus and renders the confirmation page.
Seed must refuse in production. `bun test` tests source, not the image. `bun build:old` retains the old artifact path.
Docker is a disposable, dedicated nested daemon selected by PATH. No real credentials or data are present.
